# SYNTHESISs with `line` `formal-apparatus`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Formal apparatus** — results that hold whatever any substantive line concludes — gluing and contextuality, comparison of experiments and probes, identifiability, conservation, and thresholds for naming a unit; held as a second line by the general results other lines borrow, so that setting a substantive line aside does not retire them (ADR-040).

Thwarting needs a member that acts toward its demand while the demand goes unmet. Putting [CLAIM-347](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md)'s requirement complex beside [CLAIM-549](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-549.md)'s quiescent complex shows that neither decides when frustration forces such a member. A third complex decides it: the sets that some attainable arrangement leaves each member met or quiet. The result is derived and checked exhaustively on small instances. It is a necessary condition of thwarting, not an identification of thwarting, which still needs the causal evidence [CLAIM-357](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-357.md) and [QUESTION-131](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-131.md) ask for. | [SYNTHESIS-009](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-009.md) v2 | Records kept of each capacity a response needs bound a reserve's readiness for a contingency between the sum of their probabilities less one less their number and the weakest of them, and identify it only when the capacities' dependence is known, so for any verdict that rises with readiness they can refute a required readiness when the weakest capacity falls below it and certify it only when the capacities' shortfalls together stay within its margin, leaving the band between to joint evidence such as a deadline-bound exercise; where capacities only decay between record and need, a refutation outlasts the record and a certification does not | [QUESTION-395](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-395.md) asks which observations tell a warranted reserve of specialized capability from wasteful redundancy, and which of them identify readiness ([TERM-115](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-115.md)) and which only bound it. [CLAIM-587](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-587.md) makes a response the conjunction of complementary capacities. So records kept per capacity (rosters, training assessments, equipment availability, turnout times) fix only the marginals, which bound readiness by the Fréchet inequalities and do not identify it. A record can refute a required readiness through the weakest capacity, and can certify it only when the shortfalls sum within the margin; between those, only joint evidence decides. With [CLAIM-558](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-558.md)'s decay, a certification expires with the record's age and a refutation does not. The inference leans mainly on [CLAIM-587](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-587.md); its integrating work is joining it with [TERM-115](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-115.md), [CASE-210](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-210.md)'s list of evidence and [CLAIM-558](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-558.md) to answer the question's "identify or bound" half.
